description: Runs without a proof pack (plan task P5 pod-33, docs/PROOF-HUB-API.md): every reason, and what interrupts a build.

mutations.name: HN-failed
mutations.what: a run that did not end with an answer has a pack

mutations.name: HN-subagent
mutations.what: an agent another agent started is said to have no acceptance file

mutations.name: HN-none
mutations.what: no acceptance file is a gate error

mutations.name: HN-skipped
mutations.what: a gate that did not run gives a pack

mutations.name: HN-unusable
mutations.what: an acceptance file that was lost gives a pack

mutations.name: HN-inside
mutations.what: the data folder in the workspace is a missing baseline

mutations.name: HN-final-unknown
mutations.what: an unknown final tree is not asked about

mutations.name: HN-ledger-size
mutations.what: a ledger over the limit is read
mutations.equivalent: the pack of such a ledger is over the limit as well, so encodePackFile refuses it with the same reason; this only saves the work

mutations.name: HN-sweep
mutations.what: the scratch files of a dead Hub stay

mutations.name: HN-sweep-fresh
mutations.what: the scratch files of a build that goes on are removed

mutations.name: HN-timeout
mutations.what: a build has no time limit

patches.old: const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(fault('timeout', 'the pack took too long')), this.limits.timeoutMs);

mutations.name: HN-max
mutations.what: a pack of any size is written

patches.old: diffLimits: { maxPatchBytes: limits.maxPatchBytes }, maxBytes: limits.maxBytes, signal,

mutations.name: HN-max-patch
mutations.what: a patch of any size is made

mutations.name: HN-write-failed
mutations.what: a pack that could not be written is one

mutations.name: HN-verify
mutations.what: the bytes are not checked before they are written

patches.old:
const read = readPackFile(built.packBytes, { maxBytes: limits.maxBytes });
  if (read.digest !== built.digest || taskOfPack(read.entries) !== taskId) throw

mutations.name: HN-reason-baseline
mutations.what: a baseline that cannot be read is a build error

mutations.name: HN-reason-bytes
mutations.what: missing old bytes are a build error

mutations.name: HN-reason-plain-code
mutations.what: a plain folder is a build error

mutations.name: HN-reason-verify
mutations.what: a pack that does not verify is a build error

mutations.name: HN-final-tree
mutations.what: a pack of another tree than the one the run ended on

mutations.name: HN-stop-delete
mutations.what: a delete does not stop the build

mutations.name: HN-stop-hub
mutations.what: a Hub that stops does not stop the builds

mutations.name: HN-stop-forever
mutations.what: a stop waits for a build that does not end

mutations.name: HN-settled-deleted
mutations.what: the end of a build brings a deleted task back
mutations.equivalent: delete() stops the build and waits for its end before it removes the task, so the task is still there when a build settles; this is the second line

mutations.name: HN-superseded
mutations.what: the build of an earlier run of the task goes on

mutations.name: HN-interrupted
mutations.what: a pack that was being built when the Hub died stays so

mutations.name: HN-interrupted-run
mutations.what: a run that went on when the Hub died stays so

mutations.name: HN-not-loaded
mutations.what: the summary of a task file is believed as it is

mutations.name: HN-unless
mutations.what: a build that does not listen is waited for

mutations.name: HN-lock-ledger
mutations.what: an edited ledger is not asked about
